title: Al-Risala fi Usul al-Fiqh
author: al-shafii
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Shafi'i's treatise on the sources of law: the Qur'an, the reported practice of the Prophet, consensus and analogy, and the rules for reading them together. It is the founding statement of Islamic legal methodology.
historicalContext: Written in Egypt at the end of al-Shafi'i's life. The work fixed the vocabulary of usul al-fiqh and was commented on continuously by later jurists across the schools.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
